customManagers.description: The crossplane CLI pin lives inside a `run:` body, as XP_VERSION for install.sh. No built-in manager reads it -- github-actions only sees `uses:`, `container:` and `services:` -- so the pin carries a `# renovate:` comment naming its datasource and this manager reads it. Keep the comment directly above the line holding the version.

packageRules.description: Both workflows install the same crossplane CLI and must stay on one version -- ci.yml is only a meaningful gate for release.yml if they build with the same tool. Grouping keeps them in a single PR instead of two that each leave the pair mismatched.
